title: Read a path input
summary: Ruby on Rails: Read a path input. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: A colon marks a route value. GET /hello/Ravi places Ravi in params[:name].
learningObjectives: Read a path input with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Read a path input
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/hello/:name", to: "lesson#hello"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def hello
 render plain: "Hi, #{params[:name]}!"
end
end

blocks.text: The route segment is stored in params[:name]. String interpolation reads Ravi from it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use plain text or safe templates when returning user text.
